notes: 85 synthetic task cases, 34 development / 34 validation / 17 holdout. Holdout is final-only and must not guide tuning. Controlled faults are reported separately from real Qwen. Prompt IDs resolve exclusively to fresh synthetic SQLite fixtures.
semanticThresholds: Measure baseline per split; freeze thresholds after development measurement before optimization.
